created: The reviewed existing-Issue or no-Issue source, acquisition plan, TaskId, generation-zero control state and official session binding all complete exactly once.
refresh_review: The selected base authority changed after the acquisition review.
invalid_task_state: TaskId conflicts with active, archive or unretired resource identity.
blocked: Invocation checkout, provisioned checkout, ownership transaction or session binding cannot complete; recovery remains non-success until all required state exists.
